mapper.select: SELECT id,dimension_key,sample_count,completeness,data_contract_version,evaluation_snapshot,window_start,window_end FROM (SELECT id,dimension_key,sample_count,completeness,data_contract_version,evaluation_snapshot,window_start,window_end,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY dimension_key ORDER BY id DESC) rn FROM t_alert_occurrence WHERE occurrence_type='DATA_QUALITY_SNAPSHOT') ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY dimension_key
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_occurrence WHERE occurrence_type='DATA_QUALITY_THRESHOLD' AND dimension_key=#{dimension} AND evaluation_time>=#{since}
